## FORMAT with JSON values
# Expected values: BigQuery's FORMAT documentation, which shows %p, %P, %t and %T of JSON, and
# GoogleSQL compliance functions_testlib_format_json.cc for NULL and escaped strings.
# UNNEST prevents constant folding by the analyzer.

SELECT FORMAT('%p', j) FROM UNNEST([JSON '{"month": 10, "year": 2019}']) AS j
=> "{\"month\":10,\"year\":2019}"

SELECT FORMAT('%P', j) FROM UNNEST([JSON '{"month": 10, "year": 2019}']) AS j
=> "{\n  \"month\": 10,\n  \"year\": 2019\n}"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', j) FROM UNNEST([JSON '{"name": "apple", "stock": 3}']) AS j
=> "{\"name\":\"apple\",\"stock\":3}"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', j) FROM UNNEST([JSON '{"name": "apple", "stock": 3}']) AS j
=> "JSON '{\"name\":\"apple\",\"stock\":3}'"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', JSON '{"name": "apple", "stock": 3}')
=> "JSON '{\"name\":\"apple\",\"stock\":3}'"

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T', j, j) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS JSON)]) AS j
=> "NULL|NULL"

SELECT FORMAT('%p', j) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS JSON)]) AS j
=> null

SELECT FORMAT('%P', j) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS JSON)]) AS j
=> null

SELECT FORMAT('%t', j) FROM UNNEST([JSON r"""{"a": "foo\"bar", "b": "foo\\bar", "c": "foo'bar"}"""]) AS j
=> "{\"a\":\"foo\\\"bar\",\"b\":\"foo\\\\bar\",\"c\":\"foo'bar\"}"

SELECT FORMAT('%P', j) FROM UNNEST([JSON '{"a": [null, 3, "world"], "b": {"c": false}}']) AS j
=> "{\n  \"a\": [\n    null,\n    3,\n    \"world\"\n  ],\n  \"b\": {\n    \"c\": false\n  }\n}"

SELECT FORMAT('%d', j) FROM UNNEST([JSON '1']) AS j
=> error:

SELECT FORMAT('%s', j) FROM UNNEST([JSON '"a"']) AS j
=> error:

# The literal of %T is quoted as a STRING literal, in double quotes unless the text holds one;
# width and precision act on the text as for %s; and a number that a FLOAT64 cannot hold exactly
# is rounded. Confirmed against BigQuery.
SELECT FORMAT('%T', JSON '{"a": "foo\'bar"}')
=> "JSON \"{\\\"a\\\":\\\"foo'bar\\\"}\""

SELECT FORMAT('|%20t|%-12p|%.4P|', JSON '{"a": 1}', JSON '{"a": 1}', JSON '{"a": 1}')
=> "|             {\"a\":1}|{\"a\":1}     |{\n  |"

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T', JSON '123456789012345678901', JSON '123456789012345678901')
=> "1.2345678901234568e+20|JSON \"1.2345678901234568e+20\""
